caption: Figure 1: Charon enables end-to-end, operator-level simulation for LLM training and inference. It delivers more than 30k cost reduction compared with cluster profiling for large-scale experiment, with only 3.74% total training time error on a large-scale training task.
title: Charon: A Unified and Fine-Grained Simulator for Large-Scale LLM Training and Inference
authors: Mengtian Yang, Zhekun Zhang, Mingheng Wu, Jianwen Yan, Hanshi Sun, Li-Wen Chang
